# Skillshare

> > Skillshare is an online learning platform for creatives offering classes in design, animation, photography, and creative skills, plus community events and career development resources.

Skillshare connects creative professionals through an extensive library of online courses, industry workshops, and virtual conferences. The platform features instruction from renowned designers and animators, with tools like Procreate integration and resources for freelancers and aspiring creatives.

## Key Topics

- Online Classes
- Design

## Learning Platform

- [Online Classes for Creatives | Skillshare](https://www.skillshare.com/en): Skillshare's main learning platform offering online classes in design, animation, photography, and creative skills.

## Events & Conferences

- [Dream Job Week | June 3-7](https://dreamjob.skillshare.com/): Skillshare's virtual conference for creative professionals featuring workshops and career development panels.

## Content & Resources

- [Blog for Creatives | Online Learning on Skillshare](https://prod.atlas.blog.skillshare.com/): Skillshare blog featuring articles, tutorials, and guides on drawing, painting, creativity, and productivity.
